subject: OxyWell: question set on where data is processed, subprocessors, and deletion evidence
messages:
From: Dana Ruiz <dana@oxywell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@oxywell.com
Date: Sat, 18 May 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Residency + deletion Qs for procurement

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — OxyWell's security and procurement teams asked for a compact Q&A so we can move the security review forward. Can you confirm the following in writing?

1) Exact regions where customer request payloads are processed for Redwood's hosted offering (both inference and control-plane metadata).
2) A current list of subprocessors that may receive or process customer data (including region of operation).
3) How cross-border transfers are handled (e.g., between eu/us regions, any cache or telemetry replication).
4) Retention windows for request payloads, logs, and backups and the timeline/process to permanently delete customer data on request.

We'd like short, concrete answers we can attach to our packet. If you prefer, we can take a short walk through with our InfoSec folks next week.

Appreciate the quick turn.

—Dana
Procurement Ops, OxyWell Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Ruiz <dana@oxywell.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2024 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Residency + deletion Qs for procurement

Hi Dana — thanks, and great to meet you on the call. Below are concise answers you can paste into your packet. I attached a simple residency diagram and our subprocessor inventory CSV for reference. If InfoSec wants an evidence call we can schedule next week.

1) Processing regions (hosted API):
- Inference execution (tokens, prompts, generated outputs): runs in the customer-selected region group. For OxyWell defaulting to US, we typically route to AWS us-west-2 (Oregon) or us-east-1 (N. Virginia) depending on capacity and availability.
- Control plane metadata (routing, billing metadata, anonymized telemetry): stored in our control plane which is primarily hosted in us-east-1. Control plane metadata does NOT contain full customer prompts unless the customer opts into enhanced logging for diagnostics.
- Embeddings and caches: placement may be region-local for latency-sensitive caches; persistent embeddings are stored in the region chosen at project setup.

2) Subprocessors (high level, more detail in attached CSV):
- Amazon Web Services (compute, storage): us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1 for customers that choose EU regions.
- Google Cloud Platform (analytics/backup buckets): europe-west1 (used for EU analytics pipelines).
- HashiCorp Vault / customer-supplied KMS integration partners (key management) — depends on customer configuration.
- Monitoring & logging partners (aggregated telemetry): Papertrail/LogDNA (US-based) — we only send non-sensitive telemetry; request payloads are redacted unless permitted.
- CDN/edge partners (optional): FastEdge Networks — only used when customer enables edge caching.

Note: For Redwood Private (VPC/On-prem), all processing and storage can be configured to remain inside your VPC; in that mode we do not import data into Redwood-hosted control plane except for minimal billing/metrics unless you opt in.

3) Cross-border transfers and controls:
- Default behavior: requests are routed to the selected region. We do not intentionally copy full request payloads across regions.
- Temporary cross-region failover: in the event of regional outage we failover to the next compatible region; in those cases, temporary processing may occur in a different region until capacity is restored.
- Caching and KV replication: small in-memory/redis-style caches are regional; persistent KV caches may replicate based on the chosen topology (documented in the attached diagram).
- Telemetry & metrics: aggregated metrics may be processed in the control plane (us-east-1) and may be stored in aggregated form in US-based analytics partners. We maintain controls to avoid shipping PII in telemetry — request payloads are redacted by default.

4) Retention and deletion:
- Request payloads (default hosted): transient — kept for up to 30 days to support debugging and quality monitoring. Customers can reduce this to 0 days by changing the project-level retention setting.
- Audit logs & traces: retained 365 days by default for enterprise customers; shorter windows available on request.
- Backups & snapshots: backups are kept for up to 90 days; permanent deletion from backup media can take up to 90 days.
- Deletion workflow: customers can request data deletion via the Admin API or by opening a ticket with our support team. We acknowledge and process deletion requests within 48 hours; full irreversible removal from backups and replicas is completed within 90 days. We will provide a deletion certificate on request for enterprise contracts.

If you want more precise, per-resource retention windows (e.g., embeddings vs. ephemeral prompts) we can enumerate those in a follow-up.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 21 May 2024 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Residency + deletion Qs for procurement — additional details on controls & evidence

Hi Dana — adding a couple of operational controls you asked about and what we can deliver as evidence: 

- Customer-specified region pinning: we support region pinning at the project level; if OxyWell requires strict residency we can pin both inference and persistent storage to a single region and restrict failover policies in the SLA.
- KMS & key ownership: we support customer-managed keys via integration with AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / self-hosted HSMs. With CMK enabled, we will never store plaintext model inputs in our logs or backups.
- Data access audit logs: we can provide S3 access logs and API request traces for a 90-day window as part of enterprise evidence pack.
- Deletion certificate: once deletion completes across live systems and backups we will issue a signed certificate with timestamps. Typical SLA for certificate delivery is 7 business days after irreversible deletion completes.

Attached is a short PDF that outlines the deletion workflow and timelines. If legal wants, we can provide a tailored statement of processing and flows for OxyWell (including per-resource retention numbers).

Best,
Rishi
Head of Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference
